structural_counts.notes: Ten labeled table columns represent 22 actual fitted equations: seven each in columns 1 and 6, plus eight other equations. Additional narratively described count, indicator, spline, interaction-subset and subgroup regressions are unenumerated, so total including unshown analyses is unknown. Controls count is 9 nonindustry slopes +33 industry indicators for organizational models (42); market models omit nonprofit (41). Intercepts excluded; industry is one construct represented by 33 indicators, not 33 distinct conceptual controls.

rationale: Conventional association models and substantive controls coexist with mixed-item indexes, unexplained source recodings, threshold complementarity and exploratory model selection. Commonness is a qualitative reader assessment within this supplied record, not an external prevalence survey and not a replication verdict. D1 pp7–12,15,17.

documentation_scores.rationale: Question wording, HRM families and model inclusion patterns are fairly specific. Source keys, routing, missingness, sample derivation, scale aggregation, industry crosswalk, estimator/software and covariance are absent; some coding statements conflict. Exploratory/subgroup results are unshown. D1 pp7–12,15,17–19.
